title: Chain stats row
description: A provider's per-chain market row (distinct from assets/chain.json, which is OUR registrable chain: this one carries a provider slug, its market cap and a token-platform label). Nullable figures are the norm here and MUST stay null rather than become zero - a chain whose market cap the provider omits is 'unknown', not 'worth nothing'.

slug.description: Provider slug (upstream `slug`, falling back to its `key`).

token_platform_name.description: The provider's platform label for the chain's token standard.
